headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty fell as surging crude oil prices near $114 dragged Indian equities lower.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Crude oil prices surged near $114 per barrel driven by West Asia tensions.
Global market weakness and persisting AI doubts ahead of the Fed meeting weighed on sentiment.
All major sectors closed in the red as the market snapped two-week gains.
Surging crude oil dragged Indian shares to weekly losses, with Sensex shedding 1,600 points in a turbulent week.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Nifty ended at 22,600 while Sensex extended losses for the fourth consecutive day.
BPCL reported a Q2 net profit of Rs 4,993 crore, swinging from a loss in the previous period with rebounding EBITDA.
Infosys reported a 6.2% rise in Q2 net profit to ₹7,828 crore but cut its FY27 guidance.
Godrej Properties reported a 62% decline in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹154 crore.
summary:
In the last trading session, Indian markets closed lower as crude oil prices surged near $114 per barrel amid West Asia tensions.
Nifty ended at 22,600 as selling pressure impacted all sectors in a turbulent weekly round-up.
In quarterly results, BPCL turned profitable while Infosys cut its FY27 guidance despite profit growth.
